about: ESV is a Perdomo line first released in 2005 as a tribute to Nick Perdomo Sr., then reworked in 2016 and again in 2019 as a box-pressed cigar using tobacco from the family's Finca Natalie farm. It came in three wrapper versions over Cuban-seed Nicaraguan binder and filler.

about: Legacy is a 2025 line created by Nicholas Perdomo III as a tribute to his father, Nick Perdomo Jr. It is built around a new Cuban-seed and Cameroon-seed hybrid leaf grown on the family's Finca Natalie farm in Esteli, with wrappers aged 10 years and finished in bourbon barrels.
notes: Three wrappers. Details here are the Nicaraguan Shade-Grown, a hybrid leaf that fits no standard wrapper category. The Ecuadorian Connecticut is medium (cream, cedar, honey); the Nicaraguan Maduro is medium-full (chocolate, espresso). Both use the hybrid as binder. The Gran Belicoso is box-pressed. A limited Father & Son figurado came in 2026.
